role: Boss body; cable wrap, jack and animated hands are assembled separately in Unity.
prompt: Original retro handheld brick puzzle game machine body, upright thick rectangular body with rounded beveled corners, large recessed portrait LCD screen occupying upper two thirds, screen has simple square falling-block puzzle grid, lower third has one large plus-shaped direction pad and two large circular action buttons, tiny speaker slots at bottom, thick protective side bumper. One small round headphone socket on left side. Body only, no arms, legs, hands, cables or attachments. Single isolated complete game asset. Entire object visible, centered upright, no floor or pedestal, no letters, logos or recognizable brands. Chunky premium stylized hard surfaces, clean bevels, clear silhouette from an elevated action-game camera, surface detail in PBR maps.
texture_prompt: Warm aged cream plastic front shell, thick midnight navy and dark purple protective bumper, large glass LCD with glowing cyan square grid and a few colored connected four-square falling blocks, deep purple direction pad, purple circular buttons, cyan rim accents, subtle rubbed corners and seams, rich PBR plastic and glass. No letters, words, numbers, branding or logos anywhere.
review: Meshy thumbnail and three orthographic/three-quarter Blender renders inspected. Shape and PBR accepted; final Unity assembly review is separate.
assembly_note: Overlay falling tetromino graphics on the cyan LCD. Lower cable wraps may cover the small generated pseudotext near the speaker.
